day_shape: 76 items: CENTCOM strikes Iran after tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, US revokes Iranian oil licence, IRGC claims 85-point retaliation and drone strikes on Bahrain, Khamenei funeral procession moves through Najaf, UK summons Iran's chargé.

threads.label: Hormuz tanker attacks and US strikes
threads.summary: Saudi and Qatari tankers were struck near the Strait of Hormuz, with UKMTO confirming two vessels hit and Qatar calling the attack unacceptable. CENTCOM announced strikes on Iran in response, Washington revoked the general licence authorising Iranian oil sales, and NATO's Mark Rutte called the US action "absolutely necessary".

threads.label: Iranian claims of retaliation
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB claimed the IRGC targeted 85 points of US military facilities, launched drone strikes on US bases in Bahrain, and shot down an MQ-9 over Khorramshahr, with the Khatam al-Anbiya General Staff vowing to block US interference in Hormuz. Speaker Qalibaf listed alleged US violations of a 14-point agreement, and one IRGC Navy guard was reported martyred at Bandar Mahshahr.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral procession in Iraq
threads.summary: Regime channels ran extensive live coverage of Ali Khamenei's coffin crossing into Iraq for funeral rites in Najaf and Karbala, with Nouri al-Maliki declaring "Iran is not alone". Iran International reported organisers abruptly shortened the Tehran route and conflicting accounts over who would lead prayers in Iraq.

threads.label: UK summons Iran chargé over London stabbing
threads.summary: The FCDO summoned Iran's Chargé d'Affaires in London after two Romanian nationals were given lengthy jail sentences for the 2024 stabbing of an Iran International journalist. A German court separately heard that an alleged IRGC-linked operative sought a woman to burn a kosher shop for around €4,000.

threads.label: IDF operations in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said troops of the 679th Armored Brigade killed a Hezbollah operative in Bint Jbeil during a scan of a building where a reservist had been wounded, with an Oketz unit dog also shot dead. Separately, troops located RPGs, anti-tank missile launchers and a Hezbollah flag in a civilian home in Tallousa.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Hamas governance
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced the killing of Nukhba cell commander Ahmad Yahya Ibrahim Batsh in a northern Gaza strike and Hamouda Abu Daqa of Hamas' Military Intelligence Unit. Hamas said the head of its Gaza Emergency Committee had resigned as a first step towards dissolving the body.

threads.label: Iran human rights and health-sector toll
threads.summary: An Iran Human Rights report cited by the Jerusalem Post said Iran executed at least 370 people in the first half of 2026, including protesters and nine women. A UN OCHA ReliefWeb report found health care in Iran was impacted by explosive weapons an average of 2.5 times a day during the conflict up to the 24 June ceasefire.

events.title_en: Had it not been for the Leader's prudent measures, resistance in Iraq would not have taken shape and the country would have fallen, Seyyed Hamid Husseini
events.summary_en: Had it not been for the Leader's prudent measures, resistance in Iraq would not have taken shape and the country would have fallen, Seyyed Hamid Husseini: Before 2003, there was no resistance in Iraq, but with the occupation, resistance began in Najaf and spread to Sunni areas. ISIS, with terrorists from around the world, brought down Mosul and martyred 1,700 Shias in Samarra. The crimes of the terrorists doubled the Iraqi people's attachment to the Leader of the Revolution, because Iran's aid was decisive. Today the courtyards of the shrine are full of crowds, the doors are closed and the entire country is observing mourning for the martyred leader of the nation.

events.title_en: Iran's strategic support, the key factor in the defeat of occupiers in Iraq Seyyed Hamid Husseini, head of the Association of Iraqi Scholars
events.summary_en: Iran's strategic support, the key factor in the defeat of occupiers in Iraq Seyyed Hamid Husseini, head of the Association of Iraqi Scholars: The devotion of the followers of the Leader of the Revolution is rooted in Iran's unprecedented aid to Iraq after the 2003 occupation. With full awareness, Iran stood against the coalition of 33 countries led by America, and by sending its finest commanders, it helped the people of Iraq. American forces had advanced to near the shrines and movement in the streets was accompanied by the risk of gunfire. The Islamic Republic and the Leader of the Revolution, through crisis management, paved the way for the occupiers' flight from Iraq.

events.title: A dog of the Oketz canine unit was killed by a Hezbollah gunman in the southern Lebanon town of Bint Jbeil yesterday, before being shot dead by their handler. The military says troops of the 679th "Yiftah" Armored Brigade scanned a building in Bint Jbeil where last week a Hezbollah operative opened fire and seriously wounded a reservist with the unit. During the scans yesterday, a Hezbollah operative opened fire from the building on the forces, the military says, which killed the Oketz dog. The dog's handler, a female combat soldier operating with the reservists, returned fire and killed the gunman, according to the IDF. No soldiers were injured in the incident.
